General Surgery

Assessment, operations and recovery care for general surgical conditions, planned or in an emergency.

Book an appointment Call reception

Cash, mobile money or insuranceHow payment works
Emergency, 24 hours
+256 772 487959Or come straight to Accident & Emergency

Our surgeon sees you in the surgical clinic on Tuesdays, explains your options and what to expect, and plans your operation with you. Emergency operations, such as for appendicitis, are performed day and night.

Before any operation we explain the procedure, its benefits and risks and the anaesthetic, give you an estimate of the cost, and ask for your written consent.

What we offer

  • General surgery

    Operations for hernias, lumps and swellings, appendicitis and other abdominal conditions.

  • Emergency surgery

    Assessment and surgery for acute abdominal pain, injuries and other urgent conditions, at any hour.

  • Minor surgery

    Removal of cysts and small lumps, circumcision, draining of abscesses and wound care.

  • Injuries and wounds

    Treatment of cuts, burns and injuries, with our orthopaedic surgeon for broken bones.

  • Surgical clinic

    Assessment before an operation, and wound checks and follow-up afterwards.

Head of department

NA Nagudi Aisha Head of Theatre

Go straight to Accident & Emergency for

  • Severe or worsening pain in the abdomen
  • A hernia that has become painful, hard or cannot be pushed back
  • Heavy bleeding or a deep wound
  • Vomiting with a swollen abdomen

Call +256 772 487959 or come straight to Accident & Emergency, open 24 hours.

When to come to us

  • A lump or swelling anywhere on the body
  • A bulge in the groin or abdomen that may be a hernia
  • A wound that is not healing
  • You have been referred for an operation
  • A check after your operation

What to bring

  • Your referral letter and any scans or results
  • All the medicines you take
  • National ID, refugee ID or passport, and your insurance card or approval
  • A relative or friend to support you on the day of your operation

Common questions

Will I know the cost before my operation?

Yes. For planned operations we give you an estimate covering theatre, anaesthesia, your ward stay and medicines, so you can prepare or get approval from your insurer.

Do I need to stop eating before surgery?

Yes. Do not eat or drink for the time your surgical team tells you before the operation. This keeps you safe under anaesthesia.

How soon can I go home?

After many minor operations you go home the same day. After larger operations most patients stay a few days. Your surgeon will tell you what to expect.
